events.title: 리버풀 sell Peter Beardsley to 에버턴 for £1million. 토트넘 홋스퍼 defender Mitchell Thomas moves to 웨스트햄 유나이티드 for £500,000, and announce that injured midfielder 폴 개스코인 is set to move to Italian club 라치오 at the end of the season.

Keith Curle becomes the most expensive defender in Britain when he joins 맨체스터 시티 from 윔블던 for £2.5million. Kevin Richardson becomes the third player to leave 레알 소시에다드 for an English club this summer when he is sold to 애스턴 빌라 for £450,000.
리버풀 sell 스티브 스톤턴 to 애스턴 빌라 for £1.1million. Terry Cooper resigns as manager of Third Division club 엑서터 시티 and is replaced by Alan Ball .
Within 48 hours of leaving 엑서터 시티, Terry Cooper is named as the new 버밍엄 시티 manager.
League champions 아스널 and FA Cup winners 토트넘 홋스퍼 share the FA Charity Shield with a goalless draw at Wembley .

Mark Walters follows his former 레인저스 manager 그레임 수네스 to 리버풀 in a £1.25million deal. Don Howe 's brief return to 윔블던's coaching staff ends when he announces his decision to leave the club with immediate effect, in response to manager Ray Harford 's decision to resign from the club within the next six months. 웨스트햄 유나이티드 prepare for their First Division comeback by signing striker Mike Small from Brighton & Hove Albion for £400,000.

셰필드 웬즈데이 pay a club record £1.2million for 레인저스 and England goalkeeper Chris Woods , while 리버풀 sell defender Gary Gillespie to 셀틱 for £925,000 and 에버턴's Stuart McCall heads to 레인저스 for £1.2million. England winger Trevor Steven , formerly of 에버턴, moves to the French league champions 마르세유 , where he will play alongside fellow England international 크리스 워들 , for £5million.

토트넘 홋스퍼 pay a club record £2.2million for 첼시 and Scotland striker Gordon Durie , while 코번트리 시티 pay a tiny fraction of that fee when signing Zimbabwean striker Peter Ndlovu from Highlanders for £10,000.

The Football League season begins. 아스널 begin their defence of the First Division title with a 1–1 home draw against 퀸스 파크 레인저스 . 맨체스터 유나이티드 beat newly promoted 노츠 카운티 2–0 at Old Trafford . The new 애스턴 빌라 manager Ron Atkinson begins with a 3–2 away win over his old club 셰필드 웬즈데이 . 토트넘 홋스퍼 's new head coach Peter Shreeves begins his second spell in charge with a 3–2 win at 사우샘프턴 . 올덤 애슬레틱 lose 2–1 to 리버풀 at Anfield in their first top flight game for 68 years. 바닛 begin their Football League career with a 7–4 home defeat by 크루 알렉산드라 in the Fourth Division .
카디프 시티 pay a Fourth Division record fee of £100,000 for 체스터 시티 striker Carl Dale .
19-year-old midfielder Steve McManaman scores his first goal for 리버풀 in a 2–1 defeat against 맨체스터 시티 at Maine Road .
찰턴 애슬레틱 announce that they will stay at Upton Park until at least January owing to delays on the renovation of The Valley , where they last played in September 1985.
리즈 유나이티드 win 4–0 at 사우샘프턴 in the league, with 게리 스피드 and 고든 스트라컨 both scoring twice from midfield.
이언 포터필드 boosts the 첼시 midfield with a £575,000 move for 셰필드 유나이티드 's 비니 존스 .
Former 토트넘 홋스퍼 full-back 시릴 놀스 dies of cancer aged 47. Three months ago he retired as manager of 하틀리풀 유나이티드 shortly after taking them to promotion to the Third Division .

August draws to a close with 맨체스터 유나이티드 top of the First Division with 11 points from their first five games. 리버풀, 맨체스터 시티, 노팅엄 포리스트 and 토트넘 홋스퍼 occupy the next four places, while winless 셰필드 유나이티드, 퀸스 파크 레인저스 and 루턴 타운 occupy the bottom three places in the top flight. Carlton Palmer becomes the unlikely first scorer of a hat-trick in this season's First Division, finding the net three times in a 4–1 home win for 셰필드 웬즈데이 over QPR. 입스위치 타운 lead the way in the Second Division, with 브리스틀 시티 second. The playoff zone is occupied by 케임브리지 유나이티드 , 트랜미어 로버스 , 울버햄프턴 원더러스 and 레스터 시티 . 노팅엄 포리스트 sign winger Kingsley Black from 루턴 타운 for £1.5million.
